jobs.title: Sr. Developer Advocate, AI and Machine Learning
Sr. Developer Advocate, AI and Machine Learning

reading.body:
The only AI developer relations hiring captured here is two identical Databricks postings, both for a senior developer advocate in AI and machine learning, one in San Francisco and one in Seattle.

Both were posted on the same day, 2026-08-14, with the same title and the same employer. That is one company opening one role in two markets, not a function hiring broadly. Developer relations is demand-side work: it teaches developers to build on a platform, so it tracks how hard a vendor is pushing adoption rather than how much compute it is buying.

Two postings cannot show whether this function is growing or shrinking, what the roles pay, or whether they are new positions or backfills. The sources behind the count include federal, aggregated, remote, European, and company career board listings, so the absence of other employers reflects what was collected, not proof that no one else is hiring. Nothing here speaks to buildings or power.
